answer_1.quote: We propose a novel end-to-end generative retrieval framework named RARE to achieve real-time retrieval, which is the first known work on LLM-generative architecture that displays realtime retrieving on tens-of-millions scale system.
datasets: 5,000 queries and 150,000 ads collected from online interactions
synthetic data generated from real online logs
answer_1.outputs: Commercial Intents (CIs) as short texts describing commercial intentions of users or ads

answer_2.quote: We use Ad Coverage Rate (ACR), Hit Ratio (HR@K) and Mean Average Precision (MAP) to evaluate the effectiveness of RARE.
